admission.justification: Workspace selection, paired-reader admission and revival identity must agree across distinct owners to prevent cross-task roots.

applicability: Granted direct leaf role preparation, task-scoped readers and leaf session revival.
conditions: Existing master series contract and code/memory roots are product-admitted.
exclusions: Ordinary ungranted leaf enclosure preparation remains unchanged.
Separate folders are not an OS sandbox or shell-permission guarantee.

evidence: MIK-R94@v1, D63/D74 and canonical Architect amendments

statement: A granted direct leaf uses its master series checkouts without a leaf enclosure, while role reports and scratch remain in the separate admitted group; reader and revival scope derive from its canonical leaf and current grant/master contract, never caller or environment roots.
